dependency: Sites told their site partners that 4 weeks is too short to finish screening. Only Clinical Operations can change the operational screening window the sites follow.

work_items.task: Summarise the site feedback on the screening window from each site partner
Draft the investigator letter announcing the 5-week window
Activate the next wave of sites on the 4-week screening checklist

plan.title: Five-week screening window
plan.text: Clinical Operations moves the operational screening window from 4 to 5 weeks at every active site. This is an operational change, not a protocol amendment, and it is not related to patient safety, so it needs no ethics-committee step and no separate safety approval. Rollout goes through an investigator letter and the site partners. Clinical Operations updates the site screening checklist, and sites still in activation start on the new one. In return, Site Partnerships drafts the investigator letter and confirms with each site partner that their sites have received it. Site activation dates stay as planned. Fictional assumption: the checklist update takes about a week.
